Class MainViewLifecycleCoordinator

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.ui.mainview.MainViewLifecycleCoordinator
public final class MainViewLifecycleCoordinator extends Object
Coordinates simulation lifecycle transitions, tick telemetry polling, snapshot save/load actions, and cross-tab pipeline handoffs for MainView.
Version:
1.0.0-beta.3
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot
